verse.verse_1: I CALL THE night to witness when it covers over,
verse.verse_2: And the day when it shines in all its glory,
verse.verse_3: And Him who created the male and female,
verse.verse_4: That your endeavour is for different ends.
verse.verse_5: Yet he who gives to others and has fear,
verse.verse_7: We shall ease the way of fortune for him.
verse.verse_8: But he who does not give and is unconcerned,
verse.verse_10: For him We shall ease the way of adversity,
verse.verse_11: And his riches will not avail him when he falls headlong (into the Abyss).
verse.verse_12: It is indeed for Us to show the way,
verse.verse_13: And to Us belong the End and the Beginning.
verse.verse_14: So, I warn you of the blazing Fire.
verse.verse_15: No one will burn in it but the most wretched,
verse.verse_16: Who denied (the truth) and turned away.
verse.verse_18: And gives of his wealth that he may grow in virtue,
verse.verse_19: And is under no one's obligation to return his favour,
verse.verse_20: Other than seeking the glory of his Lord, most high,
